parameters.outer: four EBCH [128,64,22] blocks followed by the stated number of uniform-interleaved accumulators

proof_model.event: the sampled BA constituent has no nonzero word below the displayed minimum distance
proof_model.event_bound: Markov applied to the expected cumulative BA spectrum
proof_model.conditional_transfer: delete every nonzero row to a uniform minimum-weight subset, then use a Bernoulli change of measure and the exact structured region permutation

limitations: Nearest binary64 arithmetic makes all distance-transfer values diagnostic.
The event probability uses the binary64 expected BA spectrum and must be outward-certified if this wrapper closes.
A failure here rejects only the minimum-distance-only wrapper; it does not reject the BA constituent.
